sections.title: Foundations of Statistics and Information for Economics and Finance
sections.description: This course serves as a capstone course for PhD students and advanced Master's students who have completed first-year coursework in core quantitative fields. It bridges the gap between theoretical economic knowledge and practical computational implementation, providing essential skills for students pursuing careers in academic finance, policy analysis, and corporate finance. The course complements existing offerings in finance and macroeconomics by emphasizing the computational and information-theoretic dimensions of economic theory.
